evidence_scope: exposure audit of exam banks vs published engine logs, 2026-07-10

incident.amplifier: low-visit mills are near-deterministic, so the 2026-07-09 mill regenerated trajectories already public — items minted AFTER the leak were still derivable from it
incident.what: two KataGo GTP transcripts from the 2026-07-02 mill were committed to the public repo; they contain full play streams of milling games

note: Counts only; auditing a leak must not widen it.

remediation.policy: engine transcripts are exam content: logDir outputs stay untracked; future mills randomize openings so trajectories are not replayable
